uz-UZ.longDescription:
Alochi Monitoring — o'quvchilar uchun 1-11 sinf monitoring
testlarini o'tkazish uchun Windows desktop ilovasi.
Matematik va ingliz tili testlari. Offline rejimda ham ishlaydi.
Natijalar server bilan avtomatik sinxronlanadi.

🖥️ Alochi Monitoring
v1.0.172
macOS
Version
✨ New features
- stadium-shaped language capsule and rounder language menu
- polish the diagnostic tab panel
- simplify the diagnostic tab and make the school button a prominent primary action
- ship installer size in the manifest and prefetch it so the popover is instant
- anchored update popover with version/size/date and compact download pill
- show kind, date and short id on saved-result rows
🐛 Bug fixes
- give the dialog scrollbar its own gutter so it no longer overlaps the buttons
- skip hides the update pill only until the app is restarted
- shorten the install button label so it renders at a readable size
- size the diagnostic panel to the student form instead of stretching the form
- keep the login card a constant size when switching tabs
- stadium-shaped update pill and constant-width download capsule
- keep catalog list in place after a test download
🔧 Other changes
- bump version to 1.0.172+172
